integrity: The proof is symbolic and unconditional within its stated domain. Finite computations corroborate the identities and equality cases but do not establish the universal statements. No exhaustive historical priority certification is claimed.

title: Exact parabolic Fourier deficit and extremizer rigidity over prime-square rings
